title: Ola Roadster Electric Superbike Concept
description: Representing Ola Electric's prowess in the Urban Electric Scooter class, the Ola Electric Ola Roadster Electric Superbike Concept is tuned for uncompromising circuit performance with laser-guided cornering stability. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 110 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights and a comfortable Step-Through Upright layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
